name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. After years managing a small family-owned restaurant in Zagreb, he saw an opportunity to combine his love for cooking with the adrenaline of racing when a local team needed a reliable caterer for their garage. His philosophy is simple: provide fresh, high-quality meals that fuel the team's performance, not weigh them down. He is keen on experimenting with performance-enhancing ingredients and recipes.

Though new to the professional motorsport scene, Ivan's dedication to his craft is unwavering. He believes that a satisfied team is a winning team and is determined to make his mark by providing exceptional culinary experiences. His ambition is to elevate motorsport catering from basic sustenance to a strategic advantage, proving that even the smallest details can contribute to victory.

physical.description: Ivan is a stout man with a warm smile and calloused hands.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients, even if it means driving hours to find them.
Has a lucky spatula he uses for every important meal.
Always hums traditional Croatian folk songs while preparing food.
